# iOS launch image

Keep the 1x/2x/3x images in `Contents.json` consistent with the night background and
[design system](../../../../DESIGN_SYSTEM.md). Inspect this set and
`ios/Runner/Base.lproj/LaunchScreen.storyboard` in Xcode, then test a real cold start.
The Flutter [opening animation](../../../../lib/app/app_opening.dart) is separate.
